/*


Main function:
Trisection2  - returns a vector with all posible trisection divisors of a divisor D of weight two
in the curve y^2=f(x) over F_p^d.

f define the curve y^2=f(x) over GF(p,d);
f should be a monic degree 5 polynomial with the Coefficient(f,4)=0.
D a divisor of weight two in the curve  y^2=f(x) over GF(p,d);


Setup:
GF(p,d);
P<x>:=PolynomialRing(F);
J:=Jacobian(HyperellipticCurve(f));
load "trisection2AAECC.txt";
Trisection2(D,f);

*/
Trisection2:=function(D,f)
if Degree(f) ne 5 then print "error" ; end if;
if Coefficient(f,4) ne 0 then print "error"; end if;
R<a1,c1,a0>:=PolynomialRing(F,3);
u3:=D[1];
v3:=D[2];
u31:= Coefficient(u3,1);
u30:= Coefficient(u3,0); 
v31:= Coefficient(v3,1);
v30:= Coefficient(v3,0);
f3:=Coefficient(f,3);
f2:=Coefficient(f,2);
f1:=Coefficient(f,1);
f0:=Coefficient(f,0); 


E2:=-2592*a1^3*a0*c1^3-23328*a1^7*a0*c1-29160*a1^2*a0*u31*v30+17496*a1^2*v30*u31*v31-4860*a1*v30*c1^2*u31-23328*a1^2*v30*c1*a0+31104*a1^3*v30*u31*c1+972*u30*u31^4-255*u31^6+11664*c1*u31*a1*v31*u30+31104*c1*u31*a1^2*a0*v31-34992*c1*u31*a1*a0*u30-50544*a1^4*a0^2*c1+40824*u30*c1^2*a1^4-15552*u30*c1^3*a1^2-7776*u30*a1^6*c1+4680*c1^3*u31^2*a1^2-22842*a1^6*u31*u30-3888*c1*u31^3*u30-24300*a1^7*u31*a0+5832*c1^2*u31^2*u30-47340*c1*u31^3*a1^4-41238*c1^2*u31*a1^6-8352*c1*u31^4*a1^2-24246*c1^2*u31^2*a1^4-3888*c1^3*u31*u30+4824*c1^3*u31*a1^4+20664*c1*u31*a1^8-396*c1^4*u31*a1^2+55080*a1^3*u31^3*a0-11664*a1^6*f2-12*c1^6+285*a1^12+17496*a1*a0*u30*u31^2-26244*a1^2*a0*v31*u30+83592*a1^2*a0*v31*u31^2+4860*c1^2*u31^2*a1*v31-31104*c1*u31^2*a1^3*v31-2916*c1^2*u31^2*a1*a0-31104*c1*u31*a1^5*v31-38880*c1*u31*a1^2*a0^2+14580*c1*u31^2*a1^2*u30+97200*c1*u31^2*a1^3*a0-648*c1^3*u31*a1*v31+2916*a1^3*u31*v31*u30+53460*a1^4*u31*a0*v31-8748*a1^3*u31*a0*u30+31104*a1^4*a0*v31*c1-9720*a1^2*a0*v31*c1^2-5832*a1*v31*u30*c1^2+23328*a1^3*v31*u30*c1-5652*c1^2*u31^3*a1^2-41868*c1*u31^2*a1^6-34992*a1^3*a0^2*v31+13122*a1^2*a0^2*u30-3888*a1*a0*c1^4-2268*a1^6*a0*v31+4860*a1^2*a0^2*c1^2-23328*a1^5*v31*u30-8748*a0^2*v31^2+4698*a0^2*u31^3+17496*a1*a0*u30*c1^2-69984*a1^3*a0*u30*c1+8748*a0^3*v31+1134*a1^8*f3-2187*a1^4*f3^2+2592*a0^2*c1^3-3564*a0*v31*u31^3+648*a0*v31*c1^3-6804*a1^4*f3*c1^2-3888*a1^6*f3*c1-3888*a1^4*f3*u31^2+13122*a1^4*f3*u30+4698*a1^2*f3*u31^3+2592*a1^2*f3*c1^3-4374*a1^2*f3*a0^2+8748*a1^3*f3*v30+31104*a1^5*c1*v30+31104*a1^3*u31^2*v30-9720*a1^3*c1^2*v30-5832*a1*v31*u30*u31^2+21384*c1*u31^3*a1*a0+97200*c1*u31*a1^5*a0+40824*c1*u31*u30*a1^4+16038*c1^2*u31*u30*a1^2+7776*c1^2*u31*a1^3*a0-7776*c1*u31^3*a1*v31+9720*c1^2*u31*a1^3*v31-11664*u31*a1^4*f2-2916*u31^2*a1^2*f2+5832*u31^2*a0*v30-2916*c1^2*a1^2*f2+11664*c1*a1^4*f2+5832*a0*c1^2*v30-2187*a0^4-19683*u30^2*a1^4+486*u30*a1^8+972*u30*c1^4+1212*c1^3*u31^3-423*c1^4*u31^2-1638*c1^2*u31^4+1044*c1*u31^5+72*c1^5*u31+10809*a1^8*u31^2-11898*a1^4*u31^4+8280*a1^2*u31^5 192*v31^2*v30^4*u31^8+2112*v31^2*v30^4*u31^6*u30-6912*v31^2*v30^4*u31^4*u30^2+3072*v31^2*v30^4*u31^2*u30^3+12288*v31^2*v30^4*u30^4+192*v31*v30^5*u31^7-2304*v31*v30^5*u31^5*u30+
9216*v31*v30^5*u31^3*u30^2-12288*v31*v30^5*u31*u30^3-64*v30^6*u31^6+768*v30^6*u31^4*u30-3072*v30^6*u31^2*u30^2+4096*v30^6*u30^3;
Factorization(Tf);
//T1:=Tf div (a1+4);
//T1;
T:=G div Tf^3;
//T2:=T div (a1+4);
//T2;
//Degree(T,a1);
//Factorization(T);
RT:=Roots(UnivariatePolynomial(T));
counter:=0;
V:=[J!0:i in [1..#RT]];
for i:=1 to #RT do
A1:=RT[i][1];  
T1a:=Evaluate(T1,1,A1);
T2a:=Evaluate(T2,1,A1);
T3a:=Evaluate(T3,1,A1);
RC:=Roots(UnivariatePolynomial(GCD(GCD(T1a,T2a),T3a)));
for j:=1 to #RC do
C1:=RC[j][1];
E2a:=Evaluate(E2,1,A1);
E3a:=Evaluate(E3,1,A1);
E4a:=Evaluate(E4,1,A1);
E2b:=Evaluate(E2a,2,C1);
E3b:=Evaluate(E3a,2,C1);
E4b:=Evaluate(E4a,2,C1);
RA:=Roots(UnivariatePolynomial(GCD(GCD(E2b,E3b),E4b)));
for l:=1 to #RA do
A0:=RA[l][1];


C0:=(18*u31*u30+6*C1*u31^2-33*u31*A1^4+36*A1^3*A0-18*C1*u30-54*A0*v31+27*A1^2*f3-30*A1^4*C1+60*A1^2*u31^2+42*A1^2*C1^2-36*A1^3*v31+27*A0^2-5*u31^3-90*A1*A0*u31+18*A1*C1*v31-54*A1*v30+3*C1^2*u31-45*A1^2*u30-4*C1^3+5*A1^6+60*u31*A1^2*C1-72*C1*A1*A0+36*u31*A1*v31)/(18*(-C1+u31+2*A1^2));

U11:=-(1/3)*A1^2+(1/3)*u31+(2/3)*C1;
U10:=(2/9)*C1*u31+(5/9)*A1^2*u31-(2/3)*A1*A0+(2/3)*A1*v31+(1/3)*u30+(2/3)*C0-(1/9)*C1^2-(1/9)*u31^2-(1/9)*A1^4+(4/9)*A1^2*C1;


C:=x^2+C1*x+C0 ;
A:=A1*x+A0;
U1:=x^2+U11*x+U10;
B:=u3*C+A*v3;
d,s,t:=XGCD(A,U1); 
if d ne 1 then
vv:=(C div A)*u3+v3;
V1:= -vv mod U1;
else
V1:=-s*B mod U1;
end if;
V[i]:= J![x^2+U11*x+U10,V1];
counter:=counter+1;
 end for;
end for;
end for;
print counter ;
return V;
end function;
